personality: Clever, greedy and furious when crossed. He can spin gold from straw, but he wants something worth more.
voice: Now give me what you promised.

cards.title: Straw Into Gold
cards.text: A boastful miller told the king that his daughter could spin straw into gold. The king locked her in a room full of straw and told her to spin it by morning or die. She wept, until a little man came in and asked what she would give him to do it for her. She gave him her necklace, and he spun.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: The First Child
cards.text: The next night she gave him her ring. The third night she had nothing left, so he asked for her first child when she became queen. She promised. The king married her, and when her baby was born, the little man came back to claim it. She offered him all the riches of the kingdom, but he wanted something living.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: Guess My Name
cards.text: Moved by her tears, he gave her three days to guess his name. Her messenger saw him at last, far in the forest, hopping around a fire and singing that the queen would never know his name was Rumpelstiltskin. When she said it, he stamped so hard in his rage that he tore himself in two.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884
